name: smwgraphics-global-graphics-pack
title: Global Graphics Pack
description:
Contains replacements for almost all commonly used blocks and tiles in the game.

Notes:
- The included yoshi coin animation replacement is meant to be used as a global exanimation so that the yoshi coin object functions properly.
- The .zip comes with separated .map16 files to get the correct tile replacements for the Yoshi Coin and turn blocks, as those tiles need to be replaced in order to not show garbage graphics.
- The proper GFX files have been updated to include the small pipes and translucent block replacements.

Some graphics require custom blocks:
Switch pack: on/off blocks
Brick blocks

Pipe corners and the yellow pipe block can be used for screen-scrolling pipes as well.
